title: Kris Aquino to reunite with Boy Abunda 11 years after 'The Buzz'
summary: Kris Aquino, the Queen of All Media, will be back on television to reunite with his good friend, the King of Talk Boy Abunda, 11 years since they were together on a show. Abunda himself confirmed…

blocks.text: Kris Aquino, the Queen of All Media, will be back on television to reunite with his good friend, the King of Talk Boy Abunda, 11 years since they were together on a show. Abunda himself confirmed this on his talk show, “Fast Talk with Boy Abunda,” with a fresh video clip of Aquino, saying that if she will ever return on television, the “queen” should be reunited with her “king.” “Kung babalik man, dapat ang babalikan, yung kasama mo yung hari,” she said in the clip.
